fields.label: Decision
fields.description: What was decided, in one line a stranger could follow. 'Three warehouses, not five' rather than 'warehouse discussion'.

fields.label: Raised By
fields.description: Who asked for it. Often the client, and that is the point of recording it.

fields.label: Decided By
fields.description: Who actually made the call. When a decision is questioned months later this is the field that settles it.

fields.label: Why
fields.description: The reasoning at the time. Written now while it is obvious, because in month five it will not be.

fields.label: Alternatives Considered
fields.description: What else was on the table and why it was not chosen. A decision with no alternatives recorded reads as an assumption.

fields.label: Consequences
fields.description: Cost, timeline, scope or risk. What this decision commits the project to.

fields.label: Show To Client
fields.description: On by default. A decision log the client cannot see is a private diary, not an audit trail.

fields.label: Supersedes
fields.description: A reversed decision is never deleted. It is superseded, and both remain readable — the sequence is the record.
